located_observations.observation: Lavender blue, deep plum and muted rose washes replace green dominance; fine dark contours and vein branches describe differentiated leaf turns. Petioles visibly connect into the stem cluster.
The above-soil stems continue into a visible crown and branching tapering roots in a rose/plum soil section. Fine drawn branches contrast with the soil texture.
Pen contour and short hatching describe joined wrist/palm/fingers; the thumb rests at the rim while curled fingers pass behind it. Human scale and tending contact remain clear.

The broad contrast-stroke Title anchors the right side. English companion and Subtitle precede a four-line full paragraph; a short gap then larger date/hour/place leads to access/care and invitation/URL. Stable starts avoid a corner-search route.
Large lavender/plum leaf canopy, cutaway pot and broad Title define the whole image. Practical copy reads as organized supporting density at this scale.

located_observations.observation: Syllable proportions, open counters, word spaces and baselines are stable. Date/hour en-dash shapes appear as distinct long midline bars; middle-dot optical gaps remain visible. Raster shape does not authenticate the Unicode source encoding.

located_observations.location: Leaf edges, hand hatching, cutaway rim and root endpoints
located_observations.observation: Fine contours and translucent washes remain coherent; the cutaway rim, hand contact and root endpoints are not detached or covered by text.

substantive_visual.observation: A substantial living plant, coherent stem/root continuity and adult hand tending the rim convey the plant-care content. The cutaway functions as an observational visual device.

excluded_template.observation: The leaf canopy, its connected cutaway and human contact carry the content and whole left form; image and title/text rhythm balance each other. Imagery is substantial rather than subordinate decoration on a headline/date template.
